# 4thave Vibe

> Connecting AI, Design, and Future.

## About
4thave is a personal portfolio and blog project by **sasisi344**. It focuses on:
- **AI & GenAI Implementation** (LLMs, automation, hacking)
- **Web Design & Development** (Astro, React, Tailwind)
- **Personal growth and insights** in the digital era.

## Projects
- **防音Lab** (bouon-lab.com): Specialized site for soundproofing.
- **海の上のアングラー** (kaijo-fishing.com): Information site for sea fishing ponds.
- **釣！浜名湖**: specialized fishing information site for Hamanako Lake.
- **Syllabus Hack** (syllabushack.com): Learning and exam preparation support.

## Identity
Sashishi (sasisi344) is the author. He is based in Hamamatsu, Shizuoka. He has over 20 years of web experience and currently explores development using AI agents (Antigravity).
